sources.name: ds_raw_data
sources.script:
source(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~>  ds_raw_data

typeProperties.script:
section Section1;
shared ds_raw_data = let AdfDoc = AzureStorage.DataLakeContents("https://adlspracticerk.dfs.core.windows.net/raw/nyc_museums_2023_q1.csv"),Csv = Csv.Document(AdfDoc, [Delimiter = ",", Encoding = TextEncoding.Utf8, QuoteStyle = QuoteStyle.Csv]), PromotedHeaders = Table.PromoteHeaders(Csv, [PromoteAllScalars = true]) in  PromotedHeaders;
shared UserQuery = let Source = #"ds_raw_data",
  #"Replaced value" = Table.ReplaceValue(Source, "MS", "", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"id"}),
  #"Replaced value 1" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Replaced value", "-", "", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"id"}),
  #"Trimmed text" = Table.TransformColumns(#"Replaced value 1", {{"id", each Text.Trim(_), type nullable text}}),
  #"Sorted rows" = Table.Sort(#"Trimmed text", {{"id", Order.Ascending}}),
  #"Changed column type" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#"Sorted rows", {{"id", Int64.Type}}),
  #"Uppercased text" = Table.TransformColumns(#"Changed column type", {{"museum_name", each Text.Upper(_), type nullable text}}),
  #"Replaced value 2" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Uppercased text", "Manhattan", "1", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"borough_code"}),
  #"Replaced value 3" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Replaced value 2", "Bronx", "2", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"borough_code"}),
  #"Replaced value 4" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Replaced value 3", "Brooklyn", "3", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"borough_code"}),
  #"Replaced value 5" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Replaced value 4", "Queens", "4", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"borough_code"}),
  #"Replaced value 6" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Replaced value 5", "Staten Island", "5", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"borough_code"}),
  #"Replaced value 7" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Replaced value 6", null, "0", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"borough_code"}),
  #"Replaced value 8" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Replaced value 7", "", "0", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"borough_code"}),
  #"Changed column type 1" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#"Replaced value 8", {{"borough_code", Int64.Type}}),
  #"Replaced value 9" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Changed column type 1", "UNKNOWN", "0", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"visitors"}),
  #"Replaced value 10" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Replaced value 9", "NULL", "0", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"visitors"}),
  #"Added custom" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Table.AddColumn(#"Replaced value 10", "updated_visitors", each if Text.EndsWith([visitors], "K") then Number.From(Text.BeforeDelimiter([visitors], "K")) * 1000 else Number.From([visitors])), {{"updated_visitors", Int64.Type}}),

  #"Renamed columns 1" = Table.RenameColumns(#"Removed columns 1", {{"cleaned_visitors", "visitors"}}),
  #"Reordered columns" = Table.ReorderColumns(#"Renamed columns 1", {"id", "museum_name", "borough_code", "location_coordinates", "visitors", "opened_date"}),
  #"Replaced value 11" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Reordered columns", "Unknown", "9999-12-31", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"opened_date"}),
  #"Replaced value 12" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Replaced value 11", "", "9999-12-31", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"opened_date"}),
